title: GoNext: Transpiler and Reproducibility Package
description:
GoNext is an experimental dialect of Go and a six-stage source-to-source transpiler (parsing, internal abstract syntax tree, partial semantic analysis, normalization, lowering to go/ast, emission) that implements high-level language extensions while keeping full compatibility with the Go compiler, runtime and ecosystem. The eight extensions are enums with associated data, pattern matching, named arguments, default parameter values, extension methods, generic methods, short anonymous functions and uniform function call syntax. Enums can be lowered to three representations (sealed interface, flat tagged struct, compact tagged struct that keeps pointer payloads visible to the garbage collector).

The archive also contains the reproducibility package of the accompanying article: the Go packages of the four micro-experiments, the criterion scores of the host-platform assessment, raw benchmark output, the scripts that compute all reported statistics and regenerate the figures, and a README with the exact commands.

notes: Requirements: Go 1.24 or newer; Python 3 with NumPy and Matplotlib for the analysis scripts. Reproduce all results with: bash scripts/reproduce.sh
